description:
List the 191 products in the catalog, one compact line each: id, name, category,
a one-line coverageLabel saying what was captured (signed in or logged out only), screen
counts and page url. Paged (50 by default) and filterable by category or q; the first page
also counts products per category. To find screens, search_screens is quicker.

category.description: A category or part of one, e.g. "Developer tools" or "finance".

detail.description: full adds description, tags and source.

offset.description: Results to skip; pass nextOffset from the previous page.

q.description: Words in the product's name, category or description.

name: list_products
title: List captured products
